content: Derived initial designs id 1 (FoM -0.861) and id 2 (FoM -0.965). Gain is controlled by ln1/lp1 (ln1=90n gave gain=703, ln1=45n gave gain=109). UGBW at Cc=1.0-1.5pF is limited by the 2nd pole p2=gm6/CL (CL=10pF) rather than gm1/Cc. Next step: raise gm6 (more I_2 via mn5, wider mp3) and keep balance condition S_mp3/S_mp1 = 2*S_mn5/S_mn4. Handing over to diagnoser.

Best id 1 has violated ugbw (-0.567), phm (-0.233), slewRate (-0.0915), but gain=703. Chosen lever: lower Cc from 1.5pF to 0.8pF to relieve ugbw and slewRate constraints. Expected trade-off: higher UGBW and SR, possible PM decrease unless compensated by Rc/gm6.

id 3 (Cc=0.8p) raised SR to 36.99 (feasible) and UGBW to 39.2M. id 4 tested mn1 10->18 (+80%) but UGBW only moved 39.2M->39.75M (+1.4%). Lesson: UGBW is strictly limited by the second pole p2=gm6/CL. Input pair sizing has hit diminishing returns; need more gm6 (stage 2 current mn5 and mp3 width) to push the second pole out.

Best id 3 violates ugbw (-0.437) and phm (-0.356). Chosen lever: raise gm6 by increasing mn5 (10->16) and mp3 (8->13), maintaining balance condition S_mp3/S_mp1 = 2*S_mn5/S_mn4 ~ 6.5. This pushes out the 2nd pole p2=gm6/CL, raising both UGBW and PM.

Sweep of res on id 5 found id 11 (res=3500) where phm reached 65.58 deg (feasible!). Violated constraints reduced to only ugbw (55.69 MHz vs 100 MHz target). Reward improved to -0.2608. Handing over to diagnoser to address the sole remaining constraint: ugbw.

Best id 11 has only one violated constraint: ugbw (-0.285, 55.69 MHz). Phm is feasible at 65.58 deg. Chosen lever: lower Cc from 0.8pF towards 0.5pF to push UGBW across the 100 MHz threshold. Expected trade-off: higher UGBW and SR, PM decreases slightly.

Sweep of Cc found id 16 (Cc=0.7pF) has phm=61.77 deg (feasible) with ugbw=58.62MHz (R=-0.236). At Cc=0.3pF UGBW reached 81.4MHz but PM dropped to 39.9 deg. UGBW needs more input gm1 or a combination of higher tail current/input width plus higher Rc for phase lead. Handing to diagnoser.

Best id 15 has ugbw=62.2M, PM=57.5 deg. Chosen lever: boost gm1 by increasing mn1 (10->16) and tail mn4 (5->7), rebalance mp3=9 (2*16/7=4.57), and raise Rc (3500->4500) for PM lead. Target: cross 100 MHz UGBW and 60 deg PM into feasibility.

Simulated id 17, 18, 19. id 19 achieved UGBW 93.17 MHz and PM 55.23 deg (reward -0.055), just inches from feasibility (only ugbw -0.035 and phm -0.041). Tail current mn4=7 and input pair mn1=16 successfully brought UGBW near 100M. Handing to diagnoser for final feasibility push.

Best id 19 has ugbw=93.17M (-0.035) and phm=55.23 deg (-0.041). Chosen lever: increase wn1 (2.0u->2.5u) to lift UGBW past 100 MHz, and increase Rc (5500->6500) to push PM past 60 deg. Target: cross feasibility threshold.

Candidate 26 achieved full feasibility! Reward = 0.6312, gain=667.5 V/V, phm=62.27 deg, ugbw=107.9 MHz, slewRate=56.59 V/us, noise=0.0154 V RMS. All hard constraints satisfied with 0 violations. Handing over to diagnoser for Phase 2 optimization.

Candidate 26 is feasible (FoM 0.6312). Phase 2 optimization: current is 254.3uA, while SR margin is +0.307 and gain margin is +0.539. Chosen lever: increase mn3 (3->4) to reduce both mirrored currents by 25% while maintaining stage balance. Expected effect: total current drops below 200uA, directly boosting FoM.

Candidate 32 reached FoM 0.6592 (feasible). Specs: current=249.8uA, area=7.21e-10, ugbw=101.2MHz, phm=62.01 deg, gain=678.7, SR=56.52. Both UGBW and PM margins are now tight (<2% excess margin), trading maximum current and area safely by hand. Handing over to RL for fine local refinement.

Handover to RL: Best feasible candidate 32 has FoM=0.6592 with tight binding margins (UGBW 101.2M, PM 62.0 deg). Hand sizing has reached optimal trade-off margins. Handing over to rl-strategist for Phase 3 local TD3 refinement anchored on candidate 32.

RL refinement used 500 simulator calls (100 warmup, 400 train). Best design remains candidate 32 (FoM 0.6592). Replay buffer contains 530 transitions with 8 distinct feasible designs populating the local Pareto surface. RL verified candidate 32 as a robust local optimum. Handing over to Phase 4 (Polish).

Phase 4 Polish: Candidate 32 has UGBW 101.2M and PM 62.0 deg. Chosen lever: fine sweep of Rc over [6600, 6700, 6800, 6900, 7000, 7100] on 100-ohm grid to shave layout area while maintaining UGBW >= 100M and PM >= 60 deg. Expected effect: higher FoM.

Fine polish sweep on id 32 found candidate 536 (res=6900) achieving new best FoM = 0.6631 (feasible). UGBW = 100.2 MHz, PM = 61.95 deg, area reduced to 7.139e-10 m^2 with zero violations. Handing to diagnoser.

RL refinement complete: 870 simulations used across Phase 3 rounds. Best id improved from expert candidate 536 (FoM 0.6631) to RL candidate 596 (FoM 0.6822). Feasible designs increased to 59. RL best differs by mp1=3 (vs 2), mn1=17 (vs 16), mn4=8 (vs 7), res=7000 (vs 6900), yielding lower current (237.5uA vs 249.8uA) and lower noise (7.2mV vs 15.6mV). Total simulator calls: 907. Handing over to Phase 4 Polish.
Final Polish on RL best id 596: sweep Rc [6600, 6700, 6800, 6900, 7000] to minimize resistor area while ensuring PM >= 60 and UGBW >= 100. Expected effect: higher FoM.

Polish sweep on RL best 596 found candidate 909 (res=6700) achieving best overall FoM = 0.6938 (feasible). Specs: UGBW=100.0MHz, PM=61.47 deg, current=237.5uA, area=7.037e-10 m^2, gain=326.7, SR=59.49, noise=7.24mV. All constraints satisfied with zero violations. Ready for reviewer.

Review complete: Candidate 909 is the verified global best design with FoM = 0.6938. Fully feasible across all 5 hard constraints (Gain 326.7, PM 61.47 deg, UGBW 100.0 MHz, SR 59.49 V/us, Noise 7.24 mV). Generated 62 feasible designs in 911 simulator calls over 1467.8 seconds. Explanation documented in harness_runs/harness_20261106_111015/explanation.md.
